skills.name: Platform Quality Gate v3
skills.description: Score platform native 30%, human authenticity 25%, AIDA flow 20%, food/product visualization 15%, and CTA quality 10%.
directives: Score platform native 30%, human authenticity 25%, AIDA flow 20%, food/product visualization 15%, and CTA quality 10%.
Flag generic AIDA, weak human reaction, repeated food adjectives, wrong brand timing, and multiple CTA actions.

skills.name: AI Pattern Detector v3
skills.description: Detect repeated AI food words such as soft, fresh, delicious, perfect, great, best, warm, fluffy, and filling.
directives: Detect repeated AI food words such as soft, fresh, delicious, perfect, great, best, warm, fluffy, and filling.
Detect ad phrases such as We are excited, Highly recommend, Must try, Discover our amazing, Perfect choice, and Best restaurant.
Detect identical cross-platform structure or product-description-first copy.
Require rewrite when the caption sounds like a generated brand ad rather than platform-native user behavior.

skills.name: UGC Natural Language Reviewer
skills.description: Detect AI-like expressions, unnatural user actions, promotional wording, and rewrite content into authentic conversational language.
directives: Detect AI-like expressions, unnatural user actions, promotional wording, and rewrite content into authentic conversational language.
Lower priority for phrases such as I finally stopped, I discovered, hidden gem, must try, perfect for, life-changing, and reset my body.
Prefer conversational softeners such as honestly, actually, kind of, a little, I did not expect, what surprised me was, and what I liked was.
CTA should feel like friend-to-friend conversation, not brand operation.

skills.name: UGC Logic Reviewer
skills.description: Detect unrealistic user behavior, artificial storytelling, and promotional language, then rewrite into realistic user experience content.
directives: Detect unrealistic user behavior, artificial storytelling, and promotional language, then rewrite into realistic user experience content.
Flag stories that jump from problem directly to booking, buying, or recommending without hesitation, trigger, or experience detail.
Require at least two psychological stages for social UGC: before, hesitation, during, after, or sharing.
Review whether each section answers why they went, what happened, and why it felt worth sharing.

skills.name: Platform AIDA Quality Gate v2
skills.description: Score content by Platform Fit 30%, Human Authenticity 25%, AIDA Flow 20%, Food/Product Visualization 15%, and CTA Quality 10%.
directives: Score content by Platform Fit 30%, Human Authenticity 25%, AIDA Flow 20%, Food/Product Visualization 15%, and CTA Quality 10%.
Rewrite when platform fit, human authenticity, AIDA flow, product visualization, or CTA quality falls below the publishable threshold.
Flag generic product-description AIDA when the platform needs native creator or search behavior.
